text.title: Freelancer Rate Raise Letter Template Output Contract
text.summary: Draft-07 JSON Schema for the rate-raise artefact: one new rate with the current rate and percentage, an effective date at least 30 days and one billing cycle out, value deltas cited from `inputs_used`, in-flight work protected, the letter's tone checks, the churn-risk class with its evidence and replacement plan, the single prepared concession, the T+7 follow-up paths and the written acknowledgement gate. Validator: `scripts/validate-freelancer-rate-raise-letter-template.py`.

section.title: JSON Schema (draft-07)
section.note: What the schema cannot express and the reviewer checks by hand: `schedule.days_to_effective` is at least `client.contract_notice_days` and `effective_date - letter_date` (r-grace-period-at-least-30-days); every `value_deltas[].input_name` names an entry of `inputs_used` (r-justify-with-value-delta-not-cpi); `rate.change_pct` equals `(new - current) / current x 100` (r-single-new-rate-stated); `inflight_work` lists every signed SOW, quote and prepaid period, not a sample (r-signed-work-honoured-at-old-rate); `follow_up.date` is `letter_date + 7` (r-follow-up-at-t-plus-7-with-path); the `banned_phrases_found` scan was run against the letter text with the list in r-business-notice-tone-no-apology.

example.note: Subject violations: effective immediately with a second raise this year and no documented scope change (r-grace-period-at-least-30-days); CPI as the sole justification with no value delta (r-justify-with-value-delta-not-cpi); a range instead of one number (r-single-new-rate-stated); no in-flight work protected; a 410-word letter with apology phrases, a personal-cost story and a concession inside it (r-business-notice-tone-no-apology, r-no-concession-in-the-letter); a 42%-of-revenue client classified churn with no replacement plan (r-churn-risk-classified-before-send); follow-up at day 45 and the new rate applied on silence (r-follow-up-at-t-plus-7-with-path).

antipattern.description: `days_to_effective` below 30, `billing_cycles_to_effective` 0, an effective date inside the contract notice period, or a second raise in 12 months without `scope_change_documented_at`.
antipattern.reason: r-grace-period-at-least-30-days: a raise with no runway is an ultimatum to the client's budget.

antipattern.description: `value_deltas` empty, a delta whose `input_name` is not in `inputs_used`, or `cpi_or_costs_is_sole_justification` true.
antipattern.reason: r-justify-with-value-delta-not-cpi: an inflation note tells procurement the freelancer is a cost line to cap.
r-single-new-rate-stated: the client anchors on the bottom of any range.
r-no-concession-in-the-letter: the fallback becomes the real price.

antipattern.description: `churn_risk.class` missing, or `churn` with `revenue_share_pct_t12m` above 30 and no `replacement_revenue_plan.pipeline`.
antipattern.reason: r-churn-risk-classified-before-send: the classification is the stake of the bet.

antipattern.description: `follow_up.days_after_letter` not 7, a path left generic, or `acknowledgement.new_rate_applied` true while `received_in_writing` is false.
antipattern.reason: r-follow-up-at-t-plus-7-with-path: silence produces a disputed invoice.

antipattern.description: `letter.word_count` above 250, any entry in `banned_phrases_found`, `personal_cost_narrative` true, or the letter not opening with value delivered.
antipattern.reason: r-business-notice-tone-no-apology: an apologetic letter asks permission the freelancer does not need.

text.reference: Stdlib-only validator for this contract; `--self-test` runs both examples above.
Letter and artefact skeleton with the same sections and field names.
